Finding_Title: MFA not enforced on a privileged remote-access path
Description: A privileged remote-access path in the United Kingdom entity can be used without multi-factor authentication. The exception was granted as temporary and has no review date.
Root_Cause: Inconsistent MFA policy exception that was never time-bounded.

Finding_Title: Legacy single-factor VPN accounts still active
Description: A set of legacy VPN accounts in the France entity still authenticates with a password only. A remediation project exists but has missed its target date.
Root_Cause: Service-account inventory incomplete; decommission plan slipped.

Finding_Title: Conditional access not applied to a line-of-business app
Description: One line-of-business application used in the Spain entity is excluded from the standard conditional-access baseline, so secure authentication is not consistently enforced.
Root_Cause: Application excluded from the standard identity baseline during a migration.

Finding_Title: Critical supplier onboarded without a completed security assessment
Description: A supplier rated as critical to operations in the United Kingdom was engaged before the information-security assessment was finished. The waiver remains open.
Root_Cause: Procurement pathway allowed a waiver that was not closed.

Finding_Title: Supplier register missing residual-risk owners
Description: The Germany entity supplier register lists residual risks without a named owner or review date, so treatments are not being chased.
Root_Cause: Register template does not require an owner field.

Finding_Title: Critical patches exceeding the agreed service window
Description: Several internet-facing systems in the Spain entity have critical patches older than the agreed service window.
Root_Cause: Change calendar and vulnerability SLA are not reconciled.

Finding_Title: Vulnerability scan exceptions without an expiry date
Description: Vulnerability-scan exceptions in the France entity have been accepted without an expiry or compensating control review.
Root_Cause: Exception process allows open-ended deferrals.

Finding_Title: Privileged access review not completed for two quarters
Description: The quarterly privileged-access review for the United Kingdom entity was skipped in two consecutive quarters.
Root_Cause: Review is manual and has no standing agenda item.

Finding_Title: Cloud service inventory incomplete
Description: Two departmental cloud services in the Germany entity are in use but are not on the approved cloud inventory or covered by the standard terms.
Root_Cause: Shadow IT discovered during a network review.

Finding_Title: Backup restore test overdue
Description: The agreed annual restore test for a system holding business-critical records in the United Kingdom has not been completed within the target.
Root_Cause: Test window repeatedly deferred for operational reasons.

Finding_Title: Awareness module completion below the agreed threshold
Description: Annual information-security awareness completion in the United Kingdom entity is below the threshold agreed in the training standard.
Root_Cause: Reminders are email-only and not escalated to line managers.

Finding_Title: Phishing simulation follow-up not documented
Description: Staff in the Spain entity who failed a phishing simulation did not have a documented follow-up or refresher.
Root_Cause: Follow-up is informal.

Finding_Title: New-starter induction can be completed after system access is granted
Description: In the France entity, system access can be granted before the security induction module is completed.
Root_Cause: Joiner workflow does not gate access on induction.

Finding_Title: Role-specific training not defined for privileged users
Description: Privileged users in the Germany entity receive the same awareness module as all staff; no role-specific module is defined.
Root_Cause: Only the generic module is mandated.

Finding_Title: Clear-desk checks are informal and unrecorded
Description: Clear-desk and clear-screen checks in the United Kingdom offices are done informally and are not recorded, so trend data is not available.
Root_Cause: No sampling plan exists.

Finding_Title: Remote-working guidance not reissued after a tooling change
Description: Remote-working guidance in the France entity still refers to a retired collaboration tool.
Root_Cause: Guidance is not on the document review calendar.

Finding_Title: No approved-use list for generative AI tools
Description: Staff in the United Kingdom entity have no approved-use list or data-handling rules for generative AI tools, so confidential information could be entered into public services.
Root_Cause: Emerging-technology policy has not been updated.

Finding_Title: Secure development standard does not mention AI-assisted coding
Description: The secure development standard used in the Germany entity does not cover AI-assisted coding, code-review expectations or licence obligations.
Root_Cause: Standard last reviewed before the tools were in use.

Finding_Title: Source-code access for a contractor not time-bounded
Description: A contractor in the France entity retained source-code access after the engagement ended. Access has since been removed (closed after the target date).
Root_Cause: Contractor off-boarding did not include repository access.

Finding_Title: Records of processing not updated after a system change
Description: A system change in the United Kingdom entity altered personal-data flows but the record of processing was not updated until the audit follow-up.
Root_Cause: Change process does not trigger a privacy review.

Finding_Title: Classification labels missing on a shared workspace
Description: A widely used shared workspace in the Spain entity has no default information classification, so labelling is inconsistent.
Root_Cause: Workspace template has no default label.

Finding_Title: Encryption key-rotation interval not evidenced
Description: The Germany entity could not produce evidence that cryptographic keys are rotated at the interval stated in the standard.
Root_Cause: Rotation is performed but not logged in the evidence library.

Finding_Title: Incident playbook has no payment-diversion scenario
Description: The incident playbook used in the United Kingdom entity did not include a payment-diversion or social-engineering scenario. A scenario has since been added.
Root_Cause: Playbook scoped only to technical incidents.

Finding_Title: Lessons-learned register not reviewed at management review
Description: Lessons from incidents in the France entity are recorded but were not taken to the last management review.
Root_Cause: Agenda does not include the register as a standing item.

Finding_Title: Business-continuity test limited to a table-top discussion
Description: The only continuity test in the Spain entity this year was a table-top discussion; the live failover test is still outstanding.
Root_Cause: Live test deferred because of a change freeze.

Finding_Title: Policy review dates lapsed on three core policies
Description: Three core information-security policies at Group level had passed their review dates. They have since been reviewed and reissued.
Root_Cause: Review calendar was not owned after a role change.

Finding_Title: Statement of applicability not updated after a control change
Description: A control implementation change at Group level has not yet been reflected in the statement of applicability.
Root_Cause: SoA update is a manual year-end task.

Finding_Title: Independent review of information security overdue
Description: The planned independent review at Group level started late and closed after the original target.
Root_Cause: External reviewer procurement took longer than planned.

Finding_Title: Visitor log incomplete for a server room
Description: The visitor log for a server room in the Spain entity has missing sign-out times on several days.
Root_Cause: Paper log is not reconciled to the badge system.

Finding_Title: Off-premises equipment inventory out of date
Description: Laptop and token records for off-premises equipment in the Germany entity were out of date. The inventory has been rebuilt.
Root_Cause: Leavers process did not always trigger a kit return check.

Finding_Title: Asset inventory missing a newly commissioned platform
Description: A newly commissioned platform in the United Kingdom was not added to the asset inventory at go-live. It was added before the target date.
Root_Cause: Project handover did not include the asset register.

Finding_Title: Leaver access removed after the agreed timescale
Description: Access for a leaver in the France entity was removed after the agreed timescale. The joiner-mover-leaver workflow was tightened.
Root_Cause: HR notification reached IT late.

Finding_Title: Logging not enabled on a new application
Description: Application logging was not enabled at go-live in the Spain entity. It was switched on and added to the build standard.
Root_Cause: Logging was listed as a post-go-live task and forgotten.

Finding_Title: Malware signature update lag on a small office site
Description: A small office in the Germany entity was several days behind on malware signature updates. It is now on the standard ring.
Root_Cause: A site was left on a manual update ring.

Finding_Title: Network diagram not updated after a segmentation change
Description: The network diagram used in the United Kingdom entity did not show a recent segmentation change. It has been redrawn.
Root_Cause: Document owner was on long leave.

Finding_Title: Capacity trend report not produced for two months
Description: The monthly capacity trend report in the France entity had stopped running. Monitoring of the job has been added.
Root_Cause: Report job failed silently.

Finding_Title: Screening evidence missing for a short-term contractor
Description: Screening evidence for a short-term contractor in the Spain entity could not be located. The file has been retrieved and the filing rule restated.
Root_Cause: Agency pack was not filed in the evidence library.

Finding_Title: Change tickets closed without a back-out plan
Description: A sample of change tickets in the Germany entity had been closed without a back-out plan. The field is now mandatory.
Root_Cause: Template made the field optional.

Finding_Title: Documented operating procedure outdated for a backup job
Description: The written procedure for a backup job in the United Kingdom entity described a retired tool. It has been rewritten.
Root_Cause: Procedure was not on the review calendar.

Finding_Title: Test data contained production-like personal data
Description: A test environment in the France entity contained production-like personal data. The refresh process now applies masking.
Root_Cause: A refresh process copied unmasked records.

Finding_Title: Web filtering exceptions not reviewed in twelve months
Description: Web-filtering exceptions in the Spain entity had not been reviewed for twelve months. A quarterly review is now in place.
Root_Cause: No scheduled review.

Finding_Title: Clock synchronisation drift on a logging collector
Description: A logging collector in the Germany entity had clock drift against the standard time source. Configuration has been corrected.
Root_Cause: NTP source was misconfigured after a rebuild.

Finding_Title: Acceptable-use acknowledgement not captured for new starters
Description: New starters in the United Kingdom entity were not being asked to acknowledge the acceptable-use policy. The step has been restored.
Root_Cause: The acknowledgement step was dropped from the induction checklist.

Finding_Title: Endpoint encryption status not reported to the operations meeting
Description: Endpoint encryption coverage in the France entity was not being reported. It is now a standing operations metric.
Root_Cause: Metric existed but was not on the agenda.

Finding_Title: Physical monitoring coverage gap at a loading bay
Description: A loading-bay camera in the Spain entity was offline. It has been remounted and added to the monitoring checklist.
Root_Cause: Camera had been taken down for works and not remounted.

Finding_Title: Supplier agreement missing information-security clauses
Description: A supplier agreement used in the United Kingdom entity lacked the standard information-security clauses. Clauses were added after the target date.
Root_Cause: Legal review queue was long and the finding was not escalated.

Finding_Title: Privileged utility use not logged
Description: Use of a privileged utility in the Germany entity was not being logged. A compensating control was put in place after the target.
Root_Cause: Platform limitation; a compensating control was designed late.

Finding_Title: Threat-intelligence feed not reviewed
Description: The Group threat-intelligence feed was being received but not reviewed. A weekly review is now assigned.
Root_Cause: Ownership of the review was unclear.

Finding_Title: Data-deletion request process not tested
Description: The information-deletion process in the France entity had never been end-to-end tested. A test was completed after the target date.
Root_Cause: A test case could not be agreed between teams.

Finding_Title: Project security assessment skipped for a small change
Description: A change in the Spain entity was delivered without the project security assessment required by the standard. The threshold has since been clarified.
Root_Cause: The project was classified as too small to assess.

Finding_Title: Evidence of cable-security inspection not retained
Description: Cable-security inspections in the United Kingdom entity were not leaving any retained evidence. A simple evidence rule is now in place.
Root_Cause: Inspections happened but photographs were discarded.

Finding_Title: DLP rule set not covering a new collaboration channel
Description: A new collaboration channel in the United Kingdom entity is not covered by the data-leakage-prevention rules used on the other channels.
Root_Cause: Channel was enabled as a pilot outside the standard pattern.

Finding_Title: Monitoring use-cases not defined for a payment system
Description: Security monitoring in the Germany entity does not yet include documented use-cases for a payment-related system.
Root_Cause: Use-case catalogue has not been extended to this system.

Finding_Title: Environment separation weakened by a shared service account
Description: A shared service account is used in both test and production in the France entity, weakening environment separation.
Root_Cause: A temporary account was reused and never replaced.

Finding_Title: Configuration baseline drift on a subset of endpoints
Description: A subset of endpoints in the Spain entity has drifted from the standard configuration baseline.
Root_Cause: A local administrator exception is still in place.

Finding_Title: Intellectual-property notice missing from a contractor pack
Description: The standard contractor pack at Group level does not include the current intellectual-property notice.
Root_Cause: Pack was last updated two years ago.

Finding_Title: Event-reporting channel not advertised in a local language
Description: The information-security event-reporting channel is not advertised in the local language in the Spain entity.
Root_Cause: Only the English poster was issued.

Finding_Title: Management responsibility statement not signed this year
Description: The annual management-responsibility statement for the Germany entity had not been signed. It has now been completed.
Root_Cause: The annual sign-off was missed after a leadership change.

Finding_Title: Secure coding checklist not used on a recent release
Description: A recent release in the United Kingdom entity did not use the secure coding checklist. The definition of a release has been clarified.
Root_Cause: The release was treated as a configuration change only.

Finding_Title: Contact list for authorities out of date
Description: The Group list of contacts for authorities included a retired role. It has been updated and placed on an annual review.
Root_Cause: The list is stored in a document that is rarely opened.

Finding_Title: Audit-testing protection procedure not briefed to a new auditor
Description: A visiting auditor in the France entity was not briefed on the procedure for protecting information systems during audit testing.
Root_Cause: Induction for visiting auditors is informal.
